name: ESO 238-005 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 238-005, an irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso238005-hubble
story: ESO 238-005 is a lone irregular galaxy, listed among the most isolated galaxies near us, a true space orphan. Hubble measured the brightness of its individual stars to work out how far away it lies.

claims.text: ESO238-005 is listed in the Catalog of Nearby Isolated Galaxies with morphological type T = 10
Type T = 10 means an irregular galaxy
The catalog lists the most isolated nearby galaxies, called space orphans
Hubble (program 12546) targeted ESO238-005 to measure distances from the luminosities of stars
